title.en: Apple launches a U.S. health AI usage study
title.zhHans: Apple 在美国启动健康 AI 使用研究

searchSummary.en: Apple announced a U.S. health AI usage study with OpenEvidence and a companion app, allowing recruitment of up to 200,000 eligible participants aged 21 or older.
searchSummary.zhHans: Apple 宣布在美国启动与 OpenEvidence 合作的健康 AI 使用研究及配套应用，最多招募二十万名年满二十一岁的合格参与者。

summary.en: Dated 2026-11-15: Apple announced a U.S. health AI usage study with OpenEvidence and a companion app, allowing recruitment of up to 200,000 eligible participants aged 21 or older.
summary.zhHans: 2026-11-15，Apple 宣布在美国启动与 OpenEvidence 合作的健康 AI 使用研究及配套应用，最多招募二十万名年满二十一岁的合格参与者。

narrative.en: The number is capacity, not enrollment. Participation requires an Apple Intelligence-enabled iPhone 15 Pro or later running iOS 26 or later. The app is not for diagnosis or treatment.
narrative.zhHans: 人数为容量上限，不是已入组人数；须为支持 Apple Intelligence 的 iPhone 15 Pro 或更新机型及 iOS 26 或更新系统；应用不用于诊疗。
